title: About
text:
I grew up on Oʻahu, Hawaiʻi, surrounded by beautiful landscapes that sparked my passion for the health of our environment through data insights. My first experience with computers and coding was in middle-school, which was learning Minecraft cheat commands & syntax. This began a phase in my life where I started to love learning about the inner-workings of things and seeing how I could tinker them to my liking. Even if the field of interest seemed so vast, I loved learning everything I could. This continued in highschool where I got super into my two AP classes, Calculus & Physics. Although difficult subjects, I saw beauty in the complexity of calculus equations, classical physics, & trig relationships. I also credit my awesome teachers at the time because not only did they make the material easy to learn, but I could tell they also had the same passion for their subject as I did. Towards the end of high-school, I initially wanted to go into the medical field. Once again, I took it upon myself to learn as much as I could about the human body and medicine. Then, I took AP Environmental Science class and thought the field was just as interesting and impactful as medicine.
I earned a B.S. in Global Environmental Science from the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa where I received a formal introduction to environmental systems, working with data, and coding.

 



Hobbies

Surfing, preference towards longboarding, my favorite spot surf is Ala Moana, Oʻahu.
Music, listening and making. I’ve played percussion instruments from middle-school to college, with a preference towards marching percussion. I also dabble in drumset, mostly playing at college volleyball & basketball games. I even had the opportunity to play drumset in my friend’s band for a small event during Summer 2025! Check out TCKR’s Spotify!
Reading, currently reading The Jade City by Fonda Lee but my favorite is The Dragon Republic, Book Two in R.F. Kuang’s The Poppy War Trilogy.
Anime, I believe that some of the best works of fiction are anime. I’m currently on Vinland Saga but my favorite of all time is Attack on Titan… noticing a theme yet? When I want to consume a story without a morally questionable protagonist, some anime I like are: The Apothecary Diaries, Kaguya-sama: Love is War, Sakamoto Days, and Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End.
日本語の勉強, you might have noticed the Japanese floating around the website. Inspired by my sister who lives in Japan, I wanted to learn Japanese to connect with her in another language. I started around May 2024 and I’m teaching myself!



Fun Facts

I have a twin sister!
I also know some ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi (Hawaiian language).
My favorite Pokémon are: Luxray, Espeon, Empoleon, & Garchomp

Experience
Environmental Scientist Intern - GSI Service Group, Honolulu, HI (6/24 – 12/24)

Assisted with various projects in environmental consulting, contracted by University of Hawaii, US Navy, & US Army Corps of Engineers
Collaborated with a team of environmental scientists to assure quality data and sample collection
Supported operations by drafting project work plans, coordinating with suppliers for field projects, and ensuring timely communication to meet project objectives

Sustainability Data Science Intern - Chaminade University, Honolulu, HI (9/24 – 12/24)

Collaborated with a small team and faculty mentor on mapping plastic marine debris with machine learning
Utilized RStudio for investigative research and data analysis
Applied data analysis skills to address the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals

Conducted an in-depth literature review on fecal microorganism indicators and their application in water quality assessment
Utilized RStudio to assess water quality within an urban watershed and the relationship between land use composition
Collaborated with faculty advisors to ensure the completion of thesis by December 2024

Valet Attendant - Prestige Valet Service, Honolulu, HI (3/21 – 6/24)

Executed quick and safe parking/retreival of vehicles, consistently meeting time constraints and maintaining customer satisfaction
Cooperated with fellow valets and management to optimize parking procedures
